confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors are bounded by Mazatlán snapshots (Expatistan, MazatlanLife 2024, Expat Exchange) and Mexico-wide aggregators (CityCost, BearSavings, GlobalCostData), mostly 2024-2025 data converted at an approximate MXN/USD rate; treat them as ±25%. Cappuccino is a national-average estimate with no Mazatlán-specific source. No Mazatlán wine price was found, so wine_glass is a beer-relative estimate (about 2x beer) cross-checked against a Mazatlán shop bottle price, and cocktail is anchored to 2024 Casa Analco and Ruiseñor menu prices, uplifted for inflation. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city's tourist-coast context; no accommodation prices or listings were searched or inspected. FX: the 0.6955 observation was taken from search-result summaries attributed to rba.gov.au for 15 October 2026. I did not open the RBA page directly, and a third-party 16 October figure (0.6947) was not used because it is not an RBA source. Verify against the RBA F11 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Mazatlán is a Pacific resort city in Sinaloa, so restaurant and drink anchors are based on Mazatlán snapshots where available and on Mexican national averages (CityCost, BearSavings) and Mexico City pub prices (Expatistan) where they were not. Accommodation was set by holistic judgement against Mexican Pacific resort-city tiers, not from any cited comparable.
